description: Get full prospect analysis for a specific company ticker and product. Free operation. Returns assessment status, deal score, rank, company_info (SIC codes, NAIC cocodes, licensed states, entity types, ownership), full per-year premium and complaint series for this entity, corporate hierarchy, findings, and evidence excerpts. ASSESSED subsidiary tickers work: a hierarchy.children[].ticker with has_assessment=true can be passed straight back to this tool to drill into that entity's own book; unassessed children return 404 by design (they have no analysis yet — this is not an error in your call). Embedded excerpts are capped at 20 (highest impact first); excerpt_count gives the true total — use search_excerpts for the rest. premium and complaints carry the complete per-year observation series; pass report_year to narrow to one year. Each excerpt's text_marked carries <mark>…</mark> tags identifying the most relevant product or event sentence(s) — quote or emphasize those sentences when presenting evidence, converting the tags to bold/emphasis if the rendering surface cannot display HTML. text_marked is HTML-escaped outside the tags; use the plain text field with the highlights offsets when raw text is needed.

include_highlights.description: Include per-excerpt sentence highlights (highlights spans + text_marked with <mark> tags). Defaults to true.

include_private.description: Rank within the team-entitled population by default. False requests public-only ranking for public prospects; private prospects retain private-inclusive ranking.

product_id.description: The product ID to get prospect analysis for

report_year.description: Narrow the premium/complaint series to one report year. Omit for all years — the trend is usually the actionable half.

ticker.description: Company ticker or serving alias (e.g., "CB" for Chubb, or a subsidiary ticker from hierarchy.children[].ticker)

name: get_prospect
